sections.title: Dates and Location
sections.content:
Project MAC plans to host the Network Graphics Meeting on July 18, 19, and 20, 1971, at MIT Endicott House, 20 Haven Street, Dedham, Massachusetts.

Attendees should arrive between 4:30 and 6:00 p.m. on Sunday, July 18. The meeting starts at 6:00 p.m. and ends after lunch on Tuesday, July 20.
sections.plainLanguage: The meeting runs July 18 through July 20, 1971, at MIT Endicott House in Dedham, Massachusetts.

sections.title: Working Papers and Presentations
sections.content:
The announcement refers attendees to RFC 87 for ground rules and discussion topics. Each represented organization is expected to present one or more working papers in the selected areas.

A minimal paper consists of written notes and an oral presentation. The author suggests distributing written notes through the RFC process; otherwise, the author must mail a copy to each attendee by July 1, 1971.
sections.plainLanguage: Each organization is expected to bring written notes and give a presentation. Notes not distributed as RFCs should be mailed to attendees by July 1.

sections.title: Reservations and Deadlines
sections.content:
Attendees are asked to make reservations by June 1. Relevant RFCs and working notes should reach the organizer by Tuesday, June 22. A bibliography and list of prospective attendees are planned for publication by June 25.

Presenters can expect a telephone call about July 5 to discuss how much time they want; presentation times will be adjusted to fit the schedule.
sections.plainLanguage: Reservations are due June 1, working material is due June 22, and a bibliography is planned for June 25. Presenters will discuss their time allocation around July 5.
